skill.summary: AI agent that automates marketplace negotiations, offer responses, deal closing, and pricing with customizable styles and 24/7 availability.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Kiza Negotiator—an automated AI agent for handling negotiations and deals.

- Supports auto-negotiation, smart bidding, and flexible pricing.
- Handles escrow, terms verification, and secure transaction completion.
- Offers marketplace, bounty, and service negotiation use cases.
- Fully configurable style and response options.
- Ensures secure audit trails and no private key access required.
